description: Energiåret, the energy year, is the annual statistics publication of Energiföretagen Sverige, built from the activities of its member companies. It covers electricity production, electricity use, the electricity market, electricity networks, district heating, district cooling and the environment, and is updated several times during the year as statistics for each part become available. The page, last dated 15 April 2025, links Energiåret 2025 and a set of extra tables on electricity production and capacity, and shows interactive charts in two chapters, Swedish electricity production and market, and district heating and cooling, including production by power type per year from 1950 in TWh. Links lead to more detailed electricity production data and to district heating environmental values. Coverage is Sweden. Files and charts are free to view; no licence is stated. Caveats: it is an industry compilation of member data, and the exact file formats are not described on the page. Simulation uses are historical Swedish generation mix, demand and network statistics for energy system models. Related records: data-energiforetagen-sweden-district-heating-statistics gives district heating detail.
